evidence: Registered new user QA Tester (qa.tester.2026@example.com, location Seattle WA, password 8 chars). After submit, redirected to home with header showing Sell, Cart, and user-menu (My Profile, My Listings, Log out) instead of Login/Signup, confirming signed-in session.

issue: Unauthenticated protected-route access not consistently blocked
actual: While logged out: clicking 'Add to Cart' on a product correctly redirects to /login, and clicking 'Message Seller' correctly opens a dialog with a disabled 'Log in to message' button (clear sign-in prompts). However, directly navigating to /cart or /create-listing while unauthenticated renders a completely blank page (no elements, no redirect, no sign-in message) even after waiting 2s — it does not redirect to /login or show any sign-in prompt, unlike the public /categories route which renders correctly on direct navigation.
evidence: semantic_snapshot on /cart and /create-listing while logged out returned only {url, screen} with no elements; browser_snapshot showed only empty notification regions.

Submitted login with unregistered email nonexistent.user.xyz@example.com and arbitrary password. Page remained on /login (no redirect to home), and subsequent visit to home page showed header with 'Log in'/'Sign up' links (not a signed-in user menu), confirming no authenticated session was created.

Logged in with valid email qa.tester.2026@example.com but wrong password 'wrongpassword'. Stayed on /login, and header on home page still showed 'Log in'/'Sign up' (no session), confirming incorrect password was rejected without creating a signed-in session.

issue: Wrong password is accepted for a registered account
actual: Registered account qa.tester.2026@example.com / password123, logged out, then submitted login with the correct email but wrong password 'wrongpassword' (all via in-page navigation, no reloads). The app navigated to '/' and the header immediately showed the signed-in state (Sell, Cart, user-menu) instead of remaining logged out — the incorrect password was accepted and created an authenticated session. (An earlier attempt appeared to fail only because a subsequent full page reload had reset the app's in-memory auth state, masking the actual successful login.)
evidence: After wrong-password submit: semantic_snapshot header showed header.sell, header.cart, header.user-menu (signed-in) with no header.login/header.signup present.

Attempted to register with an already-used email (dup.test.2026@example.com). A toast notification 'An account with this email already exists' appeared immediately, the page stayed on /register, and all entered field values (name, email, password, location) remained in the form for correction.

Registered account 'Dup Test User' (dup.test.2026@example.com, location Denver, CO). Attempted re-registration with the exact same email and a case-only variation (DUP.TEST.2026@EXAMPLE.COM), both using a different name/password/location ('Dup Test User Two', Miami FL) — both rejected with 'An account with this email already exists'. Logged back in with the original account and opened the create-listing form, which auto-filled Location as 'Denver, CO' (the original value), confirming the original account was not replaced/overwritten by the duplicate attempts.

Submitting the create-listing form completely empty triggered native 'required' validation (checkValidity()=false, message 'Please fill out this field') on title/description/price and blocked submission. Filling title/description/price/location but leaving category, condition, and photo unset produced toast 'Please fill in all required fields' and stayed on the form. After setting category and condition but with no photo, submit produced toast 'Please add at least one image' and still did not create a listing (page stayed on /create-listing).

Price field is a native number input with min=0 and step=0.01. Entering -5 produced checkValidity()=false with message 'Value must be greater than or equal to 0.' and clicking Create Listing was blocked (stayed on /create-listing, no listing created). Attempting to type non-numeric text 'abc' into the field was rejected outright by the browser's number-input control (fill error 'Cannot type text into input[type=number]'), confirming non-numeric prices cannot be entered/submitted.

Created listing 'Upcycled Reclaimed Wood Side Table' with 2 sample photos, description, price $89.99, category Furniture, condition Good, location Seattle WA, and Upcycled toggle on. After submit, redirected to My Listings showing the item as Active. Viewing its detail page confirmed all submitted data persisted: 2 photo thumbnails with prev/next nav, 'Upcycled' badge, title, $89.99 price, Furniture category, Good condition, Seattle WA location, description text, and seller 'Dup Test User'.

issue: No edit/update functionality for existing listings
actual: After creating a listing, checked both the 'My Listings' page (which only offers View, Mark Sold, and Delete actions per item — no Edit) and the listing's own detail page as its owner (which only shows a 'Manage Your Listings' link — no Edit button). A DOM-wide search for any button/link containing 'edit' text or aria-label on both pages returned no matches. There is no discoverable way for a seller to edit the title, description, photos, price, category, condition, location, or upcycled status of an existing listing.

evidence: On My Listings, clicking 'Mark Sold' on an Active listing immediately changed its status to 'Sold' and the button label to 'Mark Available'; clicking it again immediately reverted to 'Active'/'Mark Sold'. Clicking 'Delete' opened a 'Delete listing?' confirmation dialog with Cancel/Delete actions; confirming delete immediately removed the listing from My Listings, showing the 'No listings yet' empty state.

Created a listing ('Sold Test Lamp'), confirmed it appeared in browse (count went 10→11). After marking it Sold via My Listings, browse count returned to 10 and the item was absent from the results list; its detail page (viewed via My Listings 'View') showed 'This item is no longer available' with the purchase actions (Add to Cart / Message Seller) replaced entirely by an owner-only 'Manage Your Listings' link — no cart/purchase controls rendered. Separately, created 'Delete Test Chair', confirmed it appeared in browse (count 11), then deleted it via My Listings; browse count returned to 10 and the item was absent, confirming deleted listings are also excluded from browse and unreachable for cart/purchase actions.

Verified each filter/sort control updates the listing grid and 'N items available' count immediately with no submit step: category toggle (10→3 items), condition toggle (3→2), price-minimum drag ($0-$500→$250-$500, 2→1), Clear-all (→10), Upcycled toggle (10→5), sort to Price Low-to-High (re-ordered 45/125/175/285/320 while keeping the 5-item filtered set), and Max Distance slider to 1 mile (5→0 items, showed 'No items found' with its own Clear-all-filters action). 'Clear all filters' fully restored the original unfiltered 10-item result set.

issue: Maximum price cannot be independently filtered
actual: Category, condition, upcycled-only, and distance filters all combine correctly with sort (newest/price/distance) and every result satisfied the active criteria in each test (e.g., Furniture+New+min$250 → exactly prod-10 $320; Upcycled-only → exactly the 5 'Upcycled...' titled items, correctly sorted ascending by price). However, the 'Price Range' filter control (labeled '$0 - $500') is implemented with only a single interactive slider thumb whose aria-label is 'Minimum' (confirmed via DOM inspection: only one role=slider element inside the price filter container, and Tab from it moves focus to the next control, not a second thumb). There is no way to set a maximum price below the fixed $500 ceiling, so buyers cannot filter listings by a maximum price as required.

evidence: Search 'portland' (lowercase) matched 3 items whose location is 'Portland, OR' (case-insensitive location match). Search 'WOODEN' (uppercase) matched 'Kids Wooden Train Set' by title. Search 'sage' matched the Armchair listing via its description text 'sage green velvet'. Clearing the search box restored the full unfiltered 10-item result set.

Each search keystroke update (typing 'portland', then 'WOODEN', then 'sage', then clearing) immediately updated both the 'N items available' count and the results grid with no separate search-submit action required.

issue: Category selection from Categories page does not filter browse results
actual: On /categories, 'Furniture' showed '3 items'. Clicking the Furniture category card navigated to '/?category=furniture', but the resulting Browse page showed all 10 items unfiltered (count 'browse.count' = '10 items available'), and the Furniture checkbox in the filters panel was NOT checked (value=false). The category query parameter is not applied to the listing filter, so browse results are not restricted to the chosen category and the shown count does not match the category's actual item count.

evidence: Signed in as Sam Seller (buyer role). Opened prod-1 'Mid-Century Modern Armchair' (owned by Emma Green, not Sam). Clicked Add to Cart -> toast 'Added to cart!' shown, header cart badge updated to '1'. Navigated in-page to /cart: line item shows correct title 'Mid-Century Modern Armchair', photo present, location 'Brooklyn, NY', price '$285'. Cart total correctly computed as $285.00 (single item, matches unit price).

Immediately after clicking Add to Cart on prod-1 detail page (no reload), a toast notification 'Added to cart!' appeared and the header cart icon badge updated from empty/0 to '1' in the same render, without any manual page reload. Cart page subsequently reflected the correct item and total.

As Sam Seller (buyer role), opened prod-1 (owned by Emma Green). Clicked 'Message Seller' -> dialog 'Send a message to Emma Green' opened with empty text input and Send Message button disabled. Typed a non-empty message ('Hi Emma, is this armchair still available?...'), Send Message button became enabled, clicked it. Toast 'Message sent to seller!' appeared confirming submission.

Product detail pages (both a listing created during FT-1 and seed product prod-1) consistently present: photo(s) with prev/next navigation, title (heading), description paragraph, price, category badge ('Furniture'), condition badge ('Like New'), location with distance ('Brooklyn, NY (2.5 mi)'), listing date ('Listed 2024-11-20' / 'Listed 2026-08-25' for newly created), seller name and seller location, an 'Upcycled' badge when applicable, and availability implied by presence of active Add to Cart / Message Seller controls (vs 'This item is no longer available' state observed for sold/deleted items during FT-4). All fields matched the underlying listing data with no inconsistencies observed.

As Sam Seller: (1) Viewed prod-1 'Mid-Century Modern Armchair' owned by Emma Green (not Sam) - detail page showed only buyer actions 'Add to Cart' and 'Message Seller'; no seller-management controls (no Edit/Mark Sold/Delete/Manage link) were present. (2) Created a new listing 'CS13 Test Stool' as Sam; on /my-listings it showed 'Mark Sold' and 'Delete' management actions. (3) Viewed that own listing's detail page (product/prod-1787665894811) - it showed only a 'Manage Your Listings' link/action and NO 'Add to Cart' or 'Message Seller' buttons. This confirms seller-management actions are exposed only for the signed-in seller's own listings and are absent when viewing another seller's listing (and vice versa, buyer actions are absent on one's own listing).

issue: Seller has no way to view submitted purchase requests or buyer messages anywhere in the app
actual: Full cross-user flow executed in one continuous tab (no reloads): (1) As seller 'Sam Seller', created listing 'CS13 Test Stool' ($20, Seattle WA). (2) Logged out, registered new buyer 'Betty Buyer'. (3) As Betty, opened the listing, sent a distinctive Message Seller text ('FT22-UNIQUE-MSG: Hi Sam, I'd like to buy this stool...') which showed 'Message sent to seller!' confirmation, then added the item to cart and clicked 'Send Purchase Request' on the cart page, which showed toast 'Purchase requests sent to sellers!' and correctly emptied the cart (0 items) - confirming the cart-request-sent confirmation only fires after the request is recorded. (4) Logged out, logged back in as Sam Seller (in-page navigation only, no reloads). Checked every plausible seller-facing surface: /my-listings (only shows 'View/Mark Sold/Delete' per listing, no request/message count or badge), the listing's own product detail page as owner (only shows 'Manage Your Listings' link, no requests section), the header (only theme toggle, Sell, Cart, and user-avatar buttons - no notifications/inbox icon), and 'My Profile' (routes to a broken 404 'Page not found'). Nowhere in the app could the seller see that a purchase request was submitted for their listing, nor view Betty's buyer message ('FT22-UNIQUE-MSG...'). The seller-side viewing capability required by this checklist item does not exist in the UI.
